meetingHours.billing: Recorded meeting time is metered per minute from the first minute and billed monthly in arrears on the Workforce subscription.

grandfather.appliesTo: Companies subscribed on the legacy Workforce price (teamPlanVersion 1).
grandfather.rule: The legacy Workforce price includes 3 agent boxes: 1 dev (t3.xlarge) and 2 basic (t3.medium), applied as per-rank credits. Agents beyond that bill at their rung price. The current Workforce price includes 0.

billingRules.text: Plans bill a flat amount every month. Workforce is a flat monthly price with unlimited members; members are never billed per seat.
On the current Workforce price every agent is billed per box from the first agent, at its rung's monthly price (0 included). Legacy Workforce companies keep their included boxes (see grandfather).
Only rungs marked live have a seeded Stripe price and can be bought today; other rungs are declared prices that are not yet purchasable.

Team agent charges are written by one of two writers, selected by TEAM_AGENT_TIERED_WRITER_ENABLED. legacy-halt (default): every agent prices at the entry rung, and the writer makes no changes if it finds items written by the tiered writer. tiered: each agent prices at its own rung.
A daily reconcile sweep brings each subscription's agent lines in line with the company's current agents. Adding or removing an agent is reflected by the next sweep at the latest.
An eligible Starter company can take a free-month offer: the Workforce checkout starts with a 30-day Stripe trial, then bills normally. The offer can be used once per company.
Cancelling takes effect at the end of the paid period. The company then returns to Starter limits and agent billing stops with the subscription. No data is deleted.

writerModes.legacy-halt: Default. Every agent prices at the entry rung; halts if tiered items exist.
writerModes.tiered: Each agent prices at its own rung.
